Dylan / team —

Thanks. A couple legal notes:
1) Escrow recipient handling: we should add the escrow agent as a recipient type "Receives a Completed Copy" rather than a signer or carbon copy. That ensures they get the fully executed PDFs from DocuSign without requiring acknowledgement fields.
2) If Acme wants the escrow holder to sign an escrow acknowledgement, attach a one-page template titled "Escrow Acknowledgment" — it should be a signature-required field for the escrow agent. Otherwise, keeping them as copy-only simplifies the flow.
3) Clean copy delivery: once the envelope completes, Redwood will upload the executed Order Form and executed MSA clean copy to the shared Drive link and send the clean PDFs to Acme procurement.

Tom — based on the authority doc, please confirm signatory names and emails for Acme. We also need to confirm whether Acme requires witness signatures or notarization for the execution (uncommon, but checking).

Once we have that, Neha can assemble the invoice and Dylan can initiate the envelope.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
